podcast.title: Musical Comparisons
podcast.body: The band's sound, particularly on the track "Respector," is compared to the styles of The White Stripes and Royal Blood. "And here's a sample of a track called Respector that sounds halfway between the white stripes and royal blood."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Stepbrother Not in Band
podcast.body: Bryce Ulrich is a stepbrother to Miles and Layne Ulrich but is not a member of their band, Taipei Houston. "There is another son, Bryce, a step brother to Miles and Lane, but he's not in the bed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Viral "Eleanor Rigby" Cover
podcast.body: Taipei Houston initially gained notoriety when Lars Ulrich, the father of two band members, posted a video clip of them performing a hard and heavy version of The Beatles' "Eleanor Rigby." "They first found some notoriety when dad posted a clip of them doing a hard and heavy version of the Beatles Eleanor Rigby."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
